dataset_license: Apache-2.0; self-authored examples, no external dataset rows copied
unit_command: uv run --group train python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_finetune.py
http_transport: curl --fail-with-body through a local SSH tunnel to the public server on remote loopback port 8769; production port 8768 untouched
limitations: Only the 48 GB GPU was physically tested. Recommendations for 24 GB derive from measured allocations.
Short templated tutorial examples repeat message templates across splits. Accuracy was already perfect before training.
The authored 24-row retention panel is a smoke check, not general capability certification.
A 3641-token and a small-image QLoRA backward were exercised, not every possible 4096-token/image configuration.
The end-to-end GGUF export used the BF16-LoRA adaptation; QLoRA was verified through backward, optimizer updates and portable checkpoint save.
The tutorial probabilities are uncalibrated; no broad benchmark claim follows from their sharpening.
